text:
amy: Quick sync — we're planning to add a typed feature-flags header so the Console can toggle per-route experimental behaviors without touching prompts. Want SDK compatibility thoughts before we land on a shape.

matt: +1 need this. main concerns: compact on-the-wire format, backcompat for older SDKs, and clear telemetry tags.

sophia: What do you mean by 'typed'? JSON blob or k=v pairs? JSON is clearer but header size might be an issue for big sets.

amy: Thinking of a small typed schema like `flagName:bool|str|int` encoded as JSON map, but we could also do a compact CSV `f:1,g:beta` style. Console wants ability to add rationale metadata (e.g., rollout id).

kevin: For Go SDK I prefer simple header parsing (no heavy JSON). Default to `x-rw-flags: key1=1;key2=beta;meta=rid:1234` and have server parse. If we need structured metadata we could add `x-rw-flags-meta: json...` as an opt-in header.

jen: Telemetry: make sure we attach a sampled flag to the telemetry event e.g., `flag_rollout.id` and `flag_rollout.variant`. Otherwise Console won't be able to show which users hit the experiment.

amy: Good point. Also want graceful fallback: if SDK sees unknown header format from Console, it should ignore and continue. No breaking behavior.

matt: Implementation plan idea: 1) Add `x-rw-flags` compact form for v1 (k=v;k2=v2) 2) Add `x-rw-flags-json` for structured only used when Console requests `format: json` 3) SDKs default to v1, Console can request JSON for specific routes during canary.

sophia: Would that require server to negotiate? We could let Console set a per-route toggle that uses the JSON header on responses only for canary customers. But clients need to advertise `Accept-RW-Flags: json` if they support it.

kevin: I don't want per-request negotiation in low-level clients. Simpler: SDKs expose config `featureFlags.format = "auto|compact|json"` and we document recommended defaults per language. Then Console rollout can target SDK versions that set `format=json`.

jen: UX note: Console rollout page should show the header example and a small snippet for each SDK: python, ts, go. Also link to telemetry docs — otherwise support tickets.

amy: Agree. Migration strategy: ship parsers for both formats in all SDKs (minor release), enable default `compact`, then Console will flip `format=json` in a controlled canary while we monitor telemetry.

matt: Backcompat: ensure servers accept both `x-rw-flags` and `x-redwood-flags` (old name) during transition, but prefer single canonical header in logs.

sophia: Also watch header size limits (nginx/edge). We should limit to 4KB combined and add a server-side truncation strategy: prefer to keep rollout id + explicit true flags.

amy: Action items: amy -> draft spec for header shapes and example SDK snippets; kevin/sophia -> estimate effort to add parser in go/ts/python; jen -> mock Console UX with snippets + telemetry mapping; matt -> add server acceptance rules and size limits.

rollout-bot: Reminder: create canary experiment in Console when spec doc is ready.

amy: I'll post the spec first thing tomorrow. Thanks everyone — trying to avoid a silent break in the next SDK bump. :thumbsup:
